= Milvus
:artifactid: camel-milvus-starter

Create collections and indexes, and insert, upsert, delete, search and query entities in the Milvus vector database.

== What's inside

* xref:{csb-camel-components}::milvus-component.adoc[Milvus component], URI syntax: `milvus:collection`

Please refer to the above links for usage and configuration details.

== Maven coordinates

[source,xml]
----
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.camel.springboot</groupId>
    <artifactId>camel-milvus-starter</artifactId>
</dependency>
----
